mcp.fieldTransportTip:
Streamable HTTP: the 2026-07-28 stateless protocol. Every request carries its protocol version — no initialize handshake and no Mcp-Session-Id.
Local process: launches a command on this machine.
SSE: a deprecated session transport. Use it only when the publisher has no streamable HTTP endpoint.
mcp.transportHint_stdio: SkillStar starts this command and wires its stdio to MCP messages.
